questions.original: What kind of music do you enjoy listening to, and why does it appeal to you?
questions.paraphrased: Which music genres do you prefer, and what draws you to them?

vocab.definition: A particular style or type of music, art, or literature
To be attractive or interesting to someone

questions.original: Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument? What was your experience like?
questions.paraphrased: Did you ever try to learn an instrument? How did it go?

vocab.definition: A device used to produce music, like a guitar or piano

questions.original: Do you prefer listening to music alone or with others? What difference does it make?
questions.paraphrased: Do you enjoy music more in company or by yourself?

vocab.definition: Together with other people

questions.original: How does music affect your mood when you are feeling stressed or tired?
questions.paraphrased: What effect does music have on you when you are exhausted or under pressure?

vocab.definition: The way you feel at a particular time
Feeling worried or anxious about something
Extremely tired, with no energy left

questions.original: If you could attend any concert in the world, which artist or band would you choose?
questions.paraphrased: Which live performance would you most like to see if money was no object?

vocab.definition: To go to or be present at an event
A show or act of entertainment for an audience

questions.original: Do you think music in schools is important? Should it be a compulsory subject?
questions.paraphrased: How valuable is music education? Should all students be required to study it?

vocab.definition: Required by rules or laws; you must do it
Very useful or important

questions.original: How has your taste in music changed since you were younger?
questions.paraphrased: In what ways have your musical preferences evolved over the years?

vocab.definition: The things you like or prefer
Developed gradually over time

questions.original: What role does music play in Austrian culture compared to other countries?
questions.paraphrased: How important is music in Austria's culture relative to other nations?

vocab.definition: The purpose or function of something in a situation
Compared with; in relation to

questions.original: Do you enjoy spending time in nature? What activities do you like to do outdoors?
questions.paraphrased: Are you someone who likes being outside? What do you enjoy doing in the open air?

vocab.definition: Outside, not inside a building
Outside, where there is fresh air and space

questions.original: Have you ever been hiking in the Alps? Describe your experience.
questions.paraphrased: Have you ever gone on a long walk in the mountains? What was it like?

vocab.definition: Walking long distances in the countryside or mountains for pleasure

questions.original: What are the benefits of spending time in nature for young people today?
questions.paraphrased: How does being in natural surroundings help teenagers and young adults?

vocab.definition: Advantages or positive effects
The area or environment around a place or person

questions.original: Do you think young people spend enough time outdoors, or are they too focused on screens?
questions.paraphrased: Is the amount of time teenagers spend outside sufficient, or do they focus too much on devices?

vocab.definition: Enough; as much as is needed
Giving most attention to something

questions.original: If you could plan a perfect day in nature, where would you go and what would you do?
questions.paraphrased: Imagine your ideal outdoor day — where would you be and how would you spend it?

vocab.definition: Perfect; the best possible

questions.original: How has climate change affected the natural environment in Austria that you have noticed?
questions.paraphrased: What changes to nature in Austria have you observed that might be due to global warming?

vocab.definition: Long-term changes in global weather patterns
Noticed or seen something

questions.original: Should schools organise more outdoor activities and nature trips for students?
questions.paraphrased: Would it be beneficial if schools arranged more excursions into nature?

vocab.definition: To plan and arrange an event or activity
Short trips or outings, usually for education or pleasure

questions.original: What is your favourite season for being outdoors, and why?
questions.paraphrased: Which time of year do you prefer for outdoor activities, and what makes it special?

questions.original: How do you usually spend your free time with your friends?
questions.paraphrased: What activities do you and your friends typically do together when you have time off?

vocab.definition: Usually; in a way that is normal or expected

questions.original: Do you prefer having a small group of close friends or a large circle of acquaintances?
questions.paraphrased: Would you rather have a few good friends or many people you know?

vocab.definition: Friends you trust and share personal things with
People you know but who are not close friends

questions.original: How important is it for teenagers to have friends from different backgrounds?
questions.paraphrased: How valuable is it for young people to be friends with others who have different life experiences?

vocab.definition: A person's education, family, culture, and life experience
Very useful or important

questions.original: Have you ever had a disagreement with a close friend? How did you resolve it?
questions.paraphrased: Did you ever argue with a good friend? How did you sort things out?

vocab.definition: A situation where people have different opinions or arguments
To find a solution to a problem or disagreement

questions.original: Do you think social media helps or harms friendships among young people?
questions.paraphrased: Does social media improve or damage the friendships of teenagers?

vocab.definition: Causes damage or injury to something

questions.original: What qualities do you value most in a friend?
questions.paraphrased: Which characteristics are most important to you when choosing friends?

vocab.definition: Characteristics or features of a person
The qualities or features that make someone or something recognisable

questions.original: How do you think friendships change as people get older?
questions.paraphrased: In what ways do you expect your friendships to be different when you are an adult?
